version-help: English versions/help without extracting the runtime or networking
fresh-application-root: Fresh root opens usable TUI without a manually created profile
no-system-runtime: Bundled application works with no system Node or package managers on PATH
contaminated-environment: Broken runtime stubs and unrelated DSH state cannot select another runtime
cold-offline-launch: Cold first launch reaches usable UI in process-specific network isolation
storage-isolation: Application writes stay in owned storage and unrelated fixtures remain unchanged
english-default: First launch is English despite a non-English host locale
custom-provider: Real /provider UI configures devneya-ci without a DeepSeek key
streaming: Mock response streams and settles with the deterministic completion marker
authentication-failures: Invalid credential, unknown model and unreachable endpoint errors are recoverable
file-operations: Actual advertised tools read, edit and verify a disposable workspace file
shell-operation: Harmless shell command runs and reports its real exit status
approval-allow-deny: Explicit approval allows an action and denial prevents a side effect
persistence: Provider, selected model and session state survive restart
resume: Explicit session resume and actual /resume browsing work
native-modules: Required native modules load from the extracted runtime
ptc-workers: Real DSH PTC worker executes with bundled Node and no system runtime
subagents: Configured DSH child completes a deterministic mock turn
restart: /restart preserves the session and keyboard ownership
managed-updates: /update displays the devneya release URL, cannot replace the runtime and leaves the UI usable
package-installation: Attempted component installation makes no package-manager call or dependency mutation and leaves UI usable
corruption-recovery: Missing/corrupt runtime files repair without deleting credentials or sessions
concurrency: Concurrent cold launches never observe partial runtime or profile files
interrupted-extraction: A subsequent launch recovers from interrupted extraction and preserves user data
relocation: Executable alone works after relocation using paths with spaces and Unicode
terminal-behavior: Resize, multiline paste, Unicode, Ctrl+C and EOF preserve interaction
exit-failure: Normal and failed exits restore the terminal and leave no owned workers
permissions: Non-root bootstrap works and unwritable roots fail clearly
rollback: Another build of the same compatible data baseline preserves settings and sessions
